scientific_integrity: Finite graph enumeration provides exact symbolic polynomial identities; the continuum theorem follows from a positive-coefficient derivative certificate and exact endpoint factorizations, rather than from a finite sample.
scientific_limitations: Exact offline expected-cardinality comparison for two predetermined flexible vertices, with saturated Bernoulli probability q for every edge incident to a flexible vertex, on balanced 2x2 and 3x3 markets. No claims for larger or online markets. Priority comparison is necessarily qualified for unindexed equivalent work.
title: A unique flexibility reversal in the smallest saturating bipartite matching market
